Should anything continue after that, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Taking 4 as I said. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from here and won't take any more cells, so you can reach 4.
